- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Architects prioritize based on client needs, building purpose, and site constraints.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For example, a fashion company may prioritize aesthetics, while a hospital requires functionality.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Historic sites may lead architects to prioritize aesthetics, while environmental constraints may necessitate a focus on functionality.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The future of architecture is likely to focus on balancing sustainability and aesthetics due to the importance of sustainability in modern building standards.
